## Status

Labels are defined in the README under [Status labels](https://github.com/jpazvd/unicefstats-mcp#status-labels). Status describes who maintains a server, not its quality.

- [ ] **official** — published by the organisation that produces the data, or operates the platform it is served from, under its account or announced on its website
- [ ] **independent** — built by that organisation's staff in a personal capacity, not endorsed by the organisation
- [ ] **community** — built by individuals or groups with no stated affiliation to the data producer
- [ ] **commercial** — offered by a company as part of a product or a hosted or paid service, with no stated affiliation to the data producer

Maturity qualifier, if the organisation states one: beta / lab / pilot / none

Evidence for the status (organisation account, announcement on its website, README or profile statement):
